hostedSqlCompatibility.method: Read-only pg_proc SELECT; compare SQL-body MD5, signatures and SECURITY DEFINER flags against freshly migrated local PostgreSQL

functions.arguments: p_source_id text, p_lease_token uuid, p_batch jsonb
p_source_id text, p_lease_token uuid, p_batch jsonb
p_cadence_seconds integer, p_at timestamp with time zone

hostedSqlCompatibility.query: select n.nspname as schema,p.proname as function_name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,md5(p.prosrc) as body_md5,p.prosecdef as security_definer,p.proconfig as function_settings from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where (n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('lease_due_sources','complete_source_run')) or (n.nspname='tracker_private' and p.proname in ('complete_source_run','poll_slot_at')) order by n.nspname,p.proname;
